user.title: Connect to UpSnap
user.description: Use an UpSnap user with the **Read** and **Power** permissions on the devices you want to control. The UpSnap admin account also works.

data_description.url: Address of the UpSnap web interface, for example http://192.168.1.10:8090
data_description.username: An UpSnap user with the Read and Power permissions on your devices (or the UpSnap admin email).
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only if UpSnap uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with UpSnap
reauth_confirm.description: UpSnap at {url} rejected the saved credentials.

data_description.username: An UpSnap user with the Read and Power permissions on your devices (or the UpSnap admin email).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure UpSnap
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the credentials used to connect to UpSnap.

data_description.username: An UpSnap user with the Read and Power permissions on your devices (or the UpSnap admin email).

error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.no_devices: This user cannot see any device. Give it the Read permission on your devices in UpSnap.

abort.already_configured: This UpSnap server is already configured.

init.title: UpSnap options

data_description.pending_timeout: While UpSnap is turning a device on, off or restarting it, the device shows as turning on/off. If UpSnap finishes and the device has not reached the requested state yet (for example a computer still booting), keep waiting this long.

init.description: Home Assistant asks UpSnap for the state of the devices every 10 seconds, and every 3 seconds while a power action is in progress.

action_in_progress.message: A power action is already in progress for {device}.

no_power_permission.message: The UpSnap user is not allowed to power {device}. Give it the Power permission in UpSnap.

update_failed.message: Error getting the devices from UpSnap: {error}

no_devices.title: UpSnap user cannot see any device
no_devices.description: The UpSnap user used by {title} cannot see any device, so its devices are unavailable in Home Assistant. In UpSnap, give the user the **Read** permission on the devices. This message disappears as soon as the devices are visible again.
